patch.rejection_test: Feed the Claude Code adapter an otherwise valid recorded stream containing an assistant event whose message value is a string, followed by a valid result event. The adapter must ignore the unmappable event, emit no feed event for it, preserve it in stdout, and complete successfully instead of raising AttributeError.
patch.diff:
diff --git a/adapters/claude-code/run b/adapters/claude-code/run
--- a/adapters/claude-code/run
+++ b/adapters/claude-code/run
@@ -671,7 +671,11 @@ def stream_line_events(obj: dict) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
     line -- maps to nothing."""
     events: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
-    content = ((obj.get("message") or {}).get("content") or [])
+    message = obj.get("message")
+    content = message.get("content") if isinstance(message, dict) else []
+    if not isinstance(content, list):
+        content = []
     if obj.get("type") == "assistant":
         for block in content:
             if not isinstance(block, dict):
diff --git a/tests/test_adapter_claude_code.py b/tests/test_adapter_claude_code.py
--- a/tests/test_adapter_claude_code.py
+++ b/tests/test_adapter_claude_code.py
@@ -158,3 +158,17 @@ def test_claude_code_stream_missing_result_line_fails(tmp_path):
     run = run_with_stream(tmp_path, stream)
     assert run.returncode == 1
+
+
+def test_claude_code_ignores_non_object_message_payload(tmp_path):
+    """An auxiliary stream event may carry message as a scalar rather
+    than Claude's message object. It is evidence in the raw transcript,
+    but has no feed mapping and must not crash the adapter."""
+    stream = [
+        {"type": "assistant", "message": "temporarily unavailable"},
+        RESULT_LINE,
+    ]
+    run = run_with_stream(tmp_path, stream)
+    assert run.returncode == 0, run.stdout + run.stderr
+    assert json.dumps(stream[0]) in run.stdout
+    assert read_events(tmp_path) == []
+    assert json.loads(run.stdout.splitlines()[-1])["status"] == "done"
